_note: Rescuing Wick, Part A: back at the rogue camp's log at night, Fern looks at Wick and his guard (sets log_watched; the log then offers 'Sneak to Wick').

steps.text: There's {name_wick}, curled up in the far corner.
And Slate is on guard right beside him.
If I'm quick and quiet, I can reach him.
